title: Scan stories — every sweep now narrates itself into an itemised, severity-tagged report
summary: The chat narrative of a deepscan (phases, triage reasoning, 'real defect confirmed by reading…', fixes, false alarms, before → after numbers, verdict, caveats) was lost the moment the session ended; the /report page showed bare titles. Now every sweep writes an append-only scan story and it renders at /story/<session>: numbered findings tagged 🔴🟠🟡🟢 with icon + text + hover/focus tooltips, fixed / open / needs-your-call / false-alarm status, plain-English what-was-wrong · why-it-matters · what-was-done, file:line and evidence grade, a 'what this means for you' panel, before → after with % improvement, a progress line against the previous scan of the same app, tabs (Findings · How the scan unfolded · Coverage · Added to the ledger · Checked & clean · Reading this report), search, filters, collapse, copy-as-Markdown, per-finding 'copy fix prompt' and print. All six sweep commands narrate automatically. Proven on a real scan of Bug Ledger itself.

tasks.text: Wave 0 — Read Bug Ledger + the deepscan skill

bugfixes: scan.mjs --json corrupted by confirmation lines on stdout (--story, --log, --write) — moved to stderr
Live board rendered an empty coral pill on every card ([hidden] beaten by a display rule)
Search, filters, checkboxes, file pickers, caption fields and sanitizer textareas had no accessible name
Sanitizer textareas killed the focus ring with no replacement
harvest.mjs dated bugs in UTC; worklog events printed UTC clock time
Scanner did not map repo 'bugledger' to catalogue app 'Bug Ledger' (coverage read 0/0)
Story page for a legacy session with no events would have read as 'clean'
issues: No tests in the Bug Ledger repo (needs your call — one smoke test of scan.mjs --json parsing and of /api/session/event → /api/story would guard both contracts)
The in-app Browser pane became unresponsive mid-scroll; verification was completed with headless Chrome screenshots and DOM checks via the pane's JS tool
findings: The agent's narrative was never persisted anywhere — the 2,000-char notes field on a check was the only free text, so the most useful part of a deepscan evaporated
Our own scanner's high-confidence hits were ~40% false alarms on the tooling repo (it matched its own rule table) — the reason false alarms stay visible with reasons
A [hidden] attribute is silently defeated by any author display rule; the class is now in the ledger
insights: A critique is a claim: two counter-evidence sources (severity ≠ risk; reasoning traces are partly performative) reshaped the design toward action-level facts next to the prose rather than replacing it
Colour is a label, never the meaning — icon + text + a tooltip that says what to do is the minimum (WCAG 1.4.1)
In zsh, $W with a space does not word-split — a shell function is the safe way to alias a CLI in docs
